description: Reisezeit zu Agglomerationen und Kerngemeinden auf der Strasse is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Raumentwicklung ARE. Reisezeit zu Agglomerationen und Kerngemeinden ausserhalb der Agglomerationen auf dem Strassennetz. Von jeder Verkehrszone aus wird die Reisezeit zur am schnellsten erreichbaren Agglomeration resp. Kerngemeinde bestimmt. Quelle: Nationales Personenverkehrsmodell (NPVM) des UVEK. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Raumentwicklung ARE. It offers 6 resource(s) in API, HTML, SERVICE, WMS, WMTS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
